tips.text: Throw Razor Shuriken through a line of enemies or monsters; the first target takes full damage and the others take less.
Send out Living Shadow first, then use Razor Shuriken and Shadow Slash so the Shadow copies them. When you hit the same target with both, you get Energy back.
Place Living Shadow before you jump in with Death Mark. Recast it to swap back to safety when the fight turns.
Use Shadow Slash when your Shadow is next to the enemy. Only the Shadow's slash slows, so being close to them gets you the slow.
Hold your Energy and cooldowns until Death Mark lands. It repeats part of the damage you deal while the mark is on them.
Finish enemies below half health with a basic attack. Contempt for the Weak adds bonus magic damage, but only once every few seconds on the same champion.
Hitting an enemy with Shadow Slash lowers Living Shadow's cooldown, so land it on champions to get the Shadow back sooner.

combos.name: Shuriken swap mid-cast
combos.when: When you want the shuriken thrown from a better angle or want to swap in while attacking.
combos.text: Place a shadow, start Razor Shuriken, then recast Living Shadow during the cast. Zed releases the shuriken from where he stood, swaps, then throws it again.

combos.name: Double-tap escape
combos.when: When a gank goes wrong or you need to leave a fight quickly.
combos.text: Cast Living Shadow away from the enemies and recast it straight away. Zed teleports to the shadow and is out of reach.

combos.name: Death Mark shadow escape
combos.when: After the mark is applied and you have dealt your damage, or when the fight turns against you.
combos.text: Death Mark leaves a shadow where you started. Recast to swap back to it and escape while the mark still detonates.

combos.name: Death Mark burst
combos.when: When ganking a squishy target and you want to kill it before the mark detonates.
combos.text: Dash in with Death Mark first, then add the shadow, slash, shuriken and an attack. All of that damage is stored and returned when the mark goes off.

tips.text: Throw Razor Shuriken through the minion wave so it also hits the enemy champion behind it. It keeps flying after each hit.
Send Living Shadow out first, then use Razor Shuriken so you and the Shadow both hit the same enemy. Hitting with both gives you Energy back.
Use Shadow Slash when your Shadow is next to the enemy. A slash from the Shadow slows them, and a slash from Zed alone does not.
Double tap Living Shadow to swap back to the Shadow and escape. Swap forward instead if you want to catch someone.
Hit the enemy with Shadow Slash to cut Living Shadow's cooldown. That lets you reposition or attack again sooner.
Save your Energy and cooldowns for the fight after Death Mark. The mark repeats part of the damage you deal while it is on them.
Place Living Shadow before Death Mark so you have a safe way out. Swap back to the Shadow left behind before the mark triggers if the fight goes badly.
Auto attack enemies who are low on health. Contempt for the Weak adds bonus damage on the hit.

combos.name: Double tap shadow escape
combos.when: You need to escape fast or dodge an incoming skillshot or ability.
combos.text: Cast the shadow and recast right away to swap with it. This works as a quick blink back, or forward to dodge a spell.

combos.name: Shadow Q swap
combos.when: You want to poke with Q and then swap out of retaliation range.
combos.text: Recast the shadow while Zed is still throwing the shuriken. The shuriken is released from both positions, and you end up safely repositioned.

tips.text: Graves hits hardest up close, so throw Razor Shuriken from range and avoid walking into his shotgun.
Leave Smoke Screen's cloud quickly; the slow ends as soon as you step out.
Graves gains Armor from Quickdraw, so do not start a fight while he has many stacks.
Place a Shadow with Living Shadow before Death Mark so you can swap away from Graves after the burst.
Stay away from the line between Jarvan and his Demacian Standard; Dragon Strike along it knocks you up.
Place a Living Shadow before Death Mark so you can swap away to safety after the mark.
Hit Jarvan with Razor Shuriken from both you and your shadow to get your energy back.
Do not dive when Golden Aegis is ready; it slows you and shields him.
Jarvan's Cataclysm walls trap you, but your Death Mark dash can't be targeted while it starts. Don't fight inside his arena without a shadow to swap to.
Dodge Blade's Reach when you can. Kayn needs to damage you first to use Umbral Trespass at long range.
Watch for the warning on the terrain edge when Kayn is in a wall, and keep your Living Shadow ready to swap away.
Hit Kayn with Razor Shuriken while he is in a wall to cut Shadow Step short.
Hold Death Mark if you are about to be hit by Kayn's burst. Use it to escape after you have placed a shadow.
Stay near your minions or allies so Kha'Zix cannot find you isolated. His Taste Their Fear then does much less damage.
Do not trade with Kha'Zix after he disappears; his next basic attack hits harder and slows you. Wait until you see him.
Look for the fight when Kha'Zix has used Leap and Void Assault. He is easiest to catch without them.
Place Living Shadow before you use Death Mark on Kha'Zix, so you can swap back out safely after the dash.
Look for Kindred when she has used Dance of Arrows. Dive in then with Death Mark, since she is fragile.
Don't use Death Mark if Kindred has Lamb's Respite ready. She can survive inside it, and the mark's damage is wasted.
Stay out of Lamb's Respite. You can't kill anyone inside it, so wait for it to end before you fight.
Hit Kindred with Razor Shuriken and Shadow Slash from your shadow together to catch her out of position.
Throw Razor Shuriken so both you and your shadow hit Lee Sin, and you get Energy back.
Place Living Shadow before Lee Sin dives you so you can swap away from his Resonating Strike.
Lee Sin is weak to magic damage, so use Contempt for the Weak when he is low on health to finish him.
Death Mark makes you untargetable as you jump in; use it to dodge a Sonic Wave and then hit back.
Zed, throw Razor Shuriken from both you and your shadow at Master Yi for extra damage, since he often dives in alone.
Don't rely on Shadow Slash to slow Master Yi once he has Highlander active. He is immune to slows.
Save Death Mark for after he uses Alpha Strike, since it leaves him with a long cooldown. Then burst him down.
Master Yi heals with Meditate, so burst him fast and don't poke him slowly.
Cast Death Mark on Naafiri only once her Hounds' Pursuit is spent; while she is channeling, hold your burst for the right moment.
Use Shadow Slash when her Packmates gather around her; the slash hits all nearby enemies, so it clears them while hurting her.
Put your Living Shadow down before you trade, so you can swap out when she dives in with Eviscerate.
Aim Razor Shuriken so it passes through Naafiri and her Packmates; it keeps going after the first hit and still hurts every unit in the line.
Avoid using Death Mark while Nocturne's Shroud of Darkness is ready. It blocks the mark and you lose your main damage.
Bait Shroud of Darkness with Razor Shuriken first, then commit once it is used.
Place a Living Shadow before Nocturne fears you; swap to it to escape. Fear needs the tether unbroken, so get out of range.
Stay near allies when Nocturne casts Paranoia. His dash cannot be stopped by crowd control, so expect him to come for you.
Keep your distance from Shyvana early; she is weak against enemies who stay out of reach and poke her.
Avoid fighting inside her Inferno Aegis; the shield grows with you near and it explodes after.
Throw Razor Shuriken at Shyvana when she is low on fury, before she can turn into a dragon.
Place Living Shadow before you commit with Death Mark so you can swap out of her dragon form.
Do not run at Skarner in a straight line. Ixtal's Impact grabs the first champion it hits, and a nearby wall stuns you.
Keep Living Shadow ready to swap away if Skarner charges at you. Do not use it up on a trade.
Death Mark makes you untargetable as you dash, so you can dodge Impale or Skarner's engage. Do not burn it while Skarner's abilities are ready.
Skarner is tanky and keeps hitting you. Poke him with Razor Shuriken and leave when he has Shattered Earth up.
Place Living Shadow before you use Death Mark so you can swap out of Sylas's reach once the fight turns bad.
Sylas heals when he hits you with Kingslayer, so burst him down quickly instead of trading slowly.
Stay out of a straight line from Sylas. Abscond / Abduct stuns you and pulls him to you, and Zed has no way to dodge once it lands.
Death Mark makes you untargetable while you dash, so use it to avoid Sylas's Kingslayer or Chain Lash.
Sylas can take your ultimate with Hijack, so be careful about when you use Death Mark in a fight he can answer.
Dodge Rake by stepping out of its cone, then fight when it is on cooldown. Its returning blades slow you.
Start your fight with Death Mark when Talon's Shadow Assault is down, because he is much easier to catch then.
Place Living Shadow before you use Death Mark so you have a way out when the mark ends.
Hit Talon with Shadow Slash when he jumps in. You deal damage, and his Wound stacks need several of his abilities to land.
Do not try to run from Viego's Spectral Maw in a straight line; sidestep it, because it hits the first enemy in its path.
Place Living Shadow before you use Death Mark, so you have a safe way out if Viego stuns you.
Avoid fighting near Viego's Harrowed Path mist; he can sit in it unseen and gains Attack Speed there.
Do not die while Viego is near, because he can take your body and use your abilities. Back off when you are low.
Use Razor Shuriken and Shadow Slash while Viego is in the open, and avoid long trades in his Blade of the Ruined King strikes.
Don't use Death Mark on Xin Zhao when his Crescent Guard is ready; he can knock you back and you lose the combo.
Keep Living Shadow ready as an escape; Xin Zhao's Audacious Charge closes distance fast, so swap away after he commits.
Poke Xin Zhao with Razor Shuriken while he has no target to charge, and avoid fighting once he is stacking his three attacks.
Stay behind minions when Ahri has Charm ready; it stops at the first enemy it hits, so minions in the way protect you.
Walk out of the line of Orb of Deception, and avoid standing in its return path after it turns around.
Look for your all-in when Ahri's Charm is on cooldown; she is much easier to kill and cannot easily stop you.
Hold Death Mark until Spirit Rush is down; Ahri has far less safety to escape when it is on cooldown.
Hit Ahri with Shadow Slash and Razor Shuriken from both you and your shadow; that restores energy and shortens Living Shadow's cooldown.
Do not walk into Akali's smoke after Twilight Shroud; she is invisible inside it and can hit you freely.
Use Shadow Slash from a shadow to slow Akali when she dashes in, then swap away with Living Shadow.
Akali's Five Point Strike hurts most at long range. Step in close so you dodge its slow and trade with Razor Shuriken.
Place a shadow with Living Shadow before Death Mark so you can swap out of Akali's burst.
Respect Perfect Execution at low health; Akali can jump you and hit again for big damage.
Do not stand still near Akshan when your Living Shadow is on cooldown; Shadow Slash alone cannot slow him.
Akshan's Avengerang comes back after it goes out, so step out of its line to avoid being hit twice.
Watch for Akshan's Heroic Swing hooks on walls. He can swing away from your Death Mark, so wait until he has used it.
Akshan can disappear with Going Rogue near walls and brush. Do not chase him blindly into it.
Walk around Crystallize rather than into it; the wall is solid and pushes you aside. Wait until it melts before you dash in.
Sidestep Flash Frost. Getting hit leaves you slowed and open to a strong Frostbite, and the end of its range stuns.
Aim Razor Shuriken so it passes through Anivia and any minions in the way; it keeps going after a hit.
Leave Glacial Storm quickly, because it slows you and grows stronger the longer it stays. Death Mark gives a safe exit by swapping back to your Shadow.
Do not rely on killing her at the first chance. Rebirth brings her back to full health unless her egg is killed.
Throw Razor Shuriken through minions to hit Annie. Her fireballs lock onto a target, so stay out of her range.
Do not walk in when Annie's Pyromania is full. A stun in the middle of your combo gets you killed.
Place Living Shadow before Death Mark so you have a safe swap out when Annie's Tibbers arrives.
Trade with Shadow Slash after placing Living Shadow, so the shadow's slash slows Aurelion Sol and you can close in.
Stay out of Falling Star's target area when you can; getting stunned in it means a lot of damage with no way to react.
Don't stand in Singularity; it drags you toward the center and can finish you off when you're low on health.
Place a Living Shadow before using Death Mark so you can swap out before the mark pops.
Use Death Mark on Aurora when she has no Across the Veil ready; she can't easily dodge the mark's damage once it lands.
Aurora's The Weirding slows hard and knocks her back, so don't dash in with Living Shadow when it is ready. Bait it first.
Stay out of a straight line with her Twofold Hex; Razor Shuriken is a good answer back when she throws it and you step aside.
When Aurora turns invisible with Across the Veil, don't chase. Wait for her to reappear and then trade with Shadow Slash.
Avoid fighting inside the rift from Between Worlds. Enemies touching its edge are slowed, and she can hop across it to escape.
Dash in with Living Shadow and Razor Shuriken together so both hit; Azir has little burst of his own, so trade when his Sand Soldiers are away.
Death Mark him once Emperor's Divide is spent; it is his best answer to a dive, so play safer while it is ready.
Azir's Sand Soldiers deal his damage and stay put. Fight away from them, or burst him before he can reposition them.
Do not stand in a line where Emperor's Divide can reach you; it knocks you back and leaves a wall behind that blocks your path.
Place a Living Shadow before you use Death Mark so you can swap out safely from the wall or his Shifting Sands.
Dodge Sear. Without a first hit Brand can't start his combo, and a stun from Sear leaves you open.
Stand behind minions so Brand's Sear hits them first; it ends at the first unit it hits.
Move after Brand casts Pillar of Flame; it lands after a short delay, so a step sideways avoids it.
Go in with Death Mark after Brand uses his key spells. His Pyroclasm is slow at first, and Death Mark makes you untargetable while you dash.
Brand is fragile, so Shadow Slash and Razor Shuriken from a placed Living Shadow can punish him once his Sear is on cooldown.
Keep distance from Briar; Head Rush stuns you, so avoid standing where she can reach you with it.
Place Living Shadow before Death Mark so you have a safe way out if Briar commits to you.
Do not fight beside a wall when Briar is charging Chilling Scream; a full charge can knock you into it and stun you.
Briar heals by biting and bleeding you, so shorten trades with Shadow Slash and Razor Shuriken and then back away.
Keep your distance from Cassiopeia's Miasma; if it grounds you, Living Shadow swaps and Death Mark escapes won't work.
Look away from her when she casts Petrifying Gaze so you are only slowed, not stunned.
Trade when Noxious Blast is on cooldown; her damage with Twin Fang drops a lot when she can't poison you.
Hit her with Razor Shuriken from both Zed and the shadow, then Shadow Slash to close in.
Dodge Crescent Strike. If you are marked by Moonlight, back away, because Lunar Rush then comes back quickly.
Don't trade into Pale Cascade while the orbs last. Wait until the shield is gone to start your Razor Shuriken combo.
Stay out of Moonfall range when it is ready. Diana pulls you in and slows you, which wrecks your Living Shadow setup.
Place Living Shadow before you use Death Mark so you can swap out of danger afterward.
Throw Razor Shuriken through the enemy and your Living Shadow together; Zed gets Energy back when both hit the same target.
Step out of Parallel Convergence before it arms. Ekko only stuns if he walks into it, so do not fight inside it.
Hold Death Mark while Chronobreak is on cooldown. Ekko can rewind out of your combo if it is ready.
Dodge the second pass of Timewinder; it hurts more than the first. Do not stand in its field, where you are slowed.
Use Shadow Slash with your Shadow on Ekko to slow him harder and cut the Living Shadow cooldown.
Hit Ezreal with Razor Shuriken when he walks up to farm. Your shadow's shuriken adds to the damage.
Stay out of a straight line from Ezreal and walk behind minions, since Mystic Shot stops at the first enemy it hits.
Use Shadow Slash with your shadow to leave Ezreal slowed. That makes it hard for him to kite away.
Wait until Ezreal has used Arcane Shift, then go in with Death Mark. He has no easy way out.
Place Living Shadow before you commit to Ezreal, so you have a way out after the trade.
Place Living Shadow first, then look for a Shadow Slash or Razor Shuriken hit. Shadow hits slow Fizz and make him easier to catch.
Fizz can't be targeted while he is on his trident. Wait for Playful to run out before you use Death Mark on him.
Stay out of Fizz's Urchin Strike range when it is ready. Seastone Trident then adds burst if he reaches you.
Keep Zed's shadow swap ready once Fizz has used Chum the Waters. Swapping away before the shark erupts can avoid the knock up.
Don't dive on Galio when Shield of Durand is charging or ready. Its taunt will pull you into his Justice Punch.
Galio's Justice Punch can't pass through walls, so stay near terrain when you reposition.
Galio's magic shield returns after a while without damage. Poke him first, then use Razor Shuriken to burst him.
Swap with your Shadow to escape when Galio's Hero's Entrance lands. Winds of War is slow and can be dodged.
Dash in right after Hwei uses a Torment spell; he is slow to react then and easy to rush down.
Stay out of the line of Grim Visage and Gaze of the Abyss until they are used, then dash in with Death Mark and force a fight.
Move sideways while Hwei aims; Severing Bolt lands after a delay and hits harder on someone who is isolated or cannot move.
Use Living Shadow before Death Mark so you can swap back out of a fight when the mark is about to go off.
Hit Hwei with Razor Shuriken from both you and your shadow to get energy back and keep poking him.
Poke with Razor Shuriken from range, and throw Living Shadow first so a second shuriken comes from the shadow.
Do not stand in a minion wave with Irelia, because Bladesurge lets her dash in and out freely.
Do not spend your burst on Defiant Dance. Wait for her to release it, then strike.
Hold Death Mark until Irelia has used Flawless Duet, because it stuns you when it hits.
Do not rely on Razor Shuriken to poke Kassadin down; Null Sphere gives him a shield and his passive cuts magic damage, so go for short trades.
Kassadin's Force Pulse slows you, so stay out of its cone when you can.
Be careful when you use Death Mark on Kassadin. He can blink away with Riftwalk, but his mana runs out if he keeps chasing you.
Look for the kill before Kassadin reaches level 6; Riftwalk gives him an easy way out afterward.
Katarina's Death Lotus can be interrupted. Fight her when she has used it, or threaten her with crowd control when she starts channeling.
Katarina's abilities all deal magic damage and she has lots of mobility. Hit her with Razor Shuriken when she Shunpos in, because she must come close to you.
Use Death Mark to dodge Katarina's burst, since you are untargetable while you dash. Swap back with your Shadow to escape.
Daggers disappear after a few seconds. Stay out of range of Bouncing Blade, and punish her with Shadow Slash when she steps in to pick up a dagger.
Do not walk up to LeBlanc carelessly. Ethereal Chains roots you if you stay tethered, so move out of the tether before it ends.
Use Razor Shuriken to hit LeBlanc and her fake image from range. Her mark and Distortion burst you if you stay close.
Attack LeBlanc first when she has just used Distortion; she can only return to safety with its recast.
Use Death Mark on LeBlanc when her Distortion is on cooldown, then swap back to your shadow before the mark goes off.
Stay out of Ring of Frost range before you dash in; being rooted next to Lissandra gets you killed.
Wait for Lissandra to spend Frozen Tomb before you go all in; she can cancel your Death Mark by freezing herself.
Sidestep Ice Shard; it slows you only on the first hit, so line up shots so a minion is not in front of you.
Use Living Shadow to swap away if Lissandra's Ring of Frost is about to land, unless you are already rooted.
Dodge Light Binding by standing behind minions. It roots only the first two enemies it hits, so make it hit them first.
Do not walk into Lucent Singularity; it slows you and shows where you are. Step around it, or go in once Lux has used it.
Go in with Death Mark when Lux's Light Binding is on cooldown, since it is her best answer to you.
Use Living Shadow to attack from a side angle. Lux's Final Spark is a line and is easy to sidestep.
Hit Lux with Razor Shuriken and Shadow Slash together to cut your Living Shadow cooldown and keep your pressure up.
Don't dive Malzahar while Void Shift is up; he takes little damage and ignores your slows. Poke him first to break it.
Stay out of Call of the Void's portals. Being silenced stops you from using Living Shadow or Death Mark.
Wait until Malzahar has used Nether Grasp before you go all in on him or his team.
Keep away from minions carrying Malefic Visions; when they die it jumps to you.
Slash Voidlings or step away from them; Malzahar's Void Swarm adds extra damage on a long fight.
Don't throw Razor Shuriken or Living Shadow into Mel while Rebuttal is up; her nova destroys projectiles. Wait until it is spent, then go in.
Death Mark is not a projectile, so Rebuttal can't stop the dash. Use it to get on Mel when she has spent her nova.
Stay out of a straight line from Mel; Solar Snare roots you, and a rooted Zed can't recast Living Shadow to escape.
Back off when you are low and Mel has been hitting you; her Overwhelm stacks can execute you on her next hit.
Place a Death Mark shadow before you commit; swapping back with it gets you out after the mark pops, even if Mel has rooted the area.
Throw Razor Shuriken through Naafiri and her Packmates; it keeps flying after a hit and hurts everything in the line.
Place Living Shadow first, then use Shadow Slash when you are close. The Shadow's slash slows her, and you cannot slow her with your own slash alone.
Do not run away while Naafiri's Hounds' Pursuit is channeling. Use Death Mark's untargetable dash, or swap away with Living Shadow, to get out of reach.
Put a Living Shadow down before Death Mark so you can swap out safely once the burst is done.
Naafiri turns untargetable with The Call of the Pack, so hold your damage until it ends.
Use Shadow Slash when Naafiri dashes in with Eviscerate and the Packmates come with her. Her trade will cost her.
Dodge Command: Attack by staying out of its path. Step aside once the ball is committed, then trade back.
Do not use Death Mark when Orianna's ball is near and her ultimate is ready. She can pull you in and stun you.
Her ball only affects the area around it. Fight where the ball is not, and watch where it lands.
Throw Razor Shuriken through her and her minions to poke. Shadows add extra throws, so place a Living Shadow first.
Place a Living Shadow before Death Mark so you can swap out safely once the mark is on.
Armor is your enemy's best answer to you, so trade early, before Qiyana can build it, and look to end the fight quickly.
Dodge Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal when you can; Qiyana is stuck without Terrashape, and the rock version hits hard once you are low.
Keep Living Shadow ready for when Qiyana dashes in with Audacity; swap away from the fight if she lands on you.
Stay away from walls and river when Qiyana has level 6; her Supreme Display of Talent stuns you near terrain, so use Death Mark's Shadow to escape.
Use Shadow Slash with your Shadow to hit her from two sides and slow her, then finish with Razor Shuriken.
Throw Razor Shuriken through Ryze and any minions in the way. It passes through every unit it hits, so it keeps going after the first.
Stay out of Spell Flux range. Once Ryze marks you with Flux, his Rune Prison roots you and his Overload hits much harder.
Place Living Shadow before you commit. Then Shadow Slash from both positions slows Ryze and cuts the cooldown of Living Shadow.
Hit Ryze with Death Mark when his Rune Prison is on cooldown. Otherwise you can be rooted after you land.
Stun or otherwise disable Ryze while he channels Realm Warp if you can, since that cancels the portal. Roam with your team when he opens one.
Stay out of Abduct's line; if the chains hit you, Sylas pulls himself to you and you are knocked up. Walk around minions so the chains have no clear path.
Throw Razor Shuriken through the wave to poke Sylas. Your shadow's throw hits him too, so use it from a different angle.
Trade when Sylas has used Chain Lash or Abscond / Abduct, because his burst and escape are on cooldown.
Do not rely on staying alive at low health in a fight. Kingslayer heals Sylas when he is hurt, so finish him quickly or back off.
Before you use Death Mark, check that Sylas can't steal it. Once he copies it, he can cast it at you.
Death Mark makes you untargetable as you dash in, so use it to dodge Sylas's chains or a Kingslayer lunge.
Bait out Scatter the Weak before you go in. After she uses it she has no way to push you away.
Stay away from Dark Spheres on the ground. If Syndra pushes one into you, you get stunned.
Dodge Syndra's Force of Will and Dark Sphere. Sidestep after a hit, because the slow makes the next spell hard to avoid.
Syndra's Unleashed Power hits harder with many spheres out. Avoid fighting near a pile of them, and never sit at low health.
Place Living Shadow before using Death Mark, so you have a safe way out when it ends.
Step out of the way of Taliyah's Threaded Volley; it flies in a fixed direction. Don't walk through her Worked Ground.
Don't dash through Unraveled Earth stones with Living Shadow or Death Mark. Detonating them stuns you.
When Taliyah casts Unraveled Earth, watch for Seismic Shove and stay out of the stones.
Death Mark is untargetable on the dash, so use it to dodge her big spells. Then she can't easily punish you.
Go in after Taliyah has used Seismic Shove, since it has a long cooldown.
Place Living Shadow before you go in, so you can swap back out if Talon dives you.
Dodge Rake by stepping sideways; it hits twice, so a hit leaves you slowed and feeds Talon's passive.
Talon can vault walls with Assassin's Path to get behind you, so stay away from walls when his jump is ready.
When Talon's Shadow Assault is down, he is much easier to catch, so look to trade or kill him with Death Mark then.
Use Razor Shuriken through minions and Talon together to poke him; its damage is reduced on later targets, so aim at Talon first.
Stay out of Twisted Fate's Wild Cards. Cross the lane at an angle and use Living Shadow to get around it.
Do not walk up to Twisted Fate while he is shuffling Pick a Card, because the Gold Card stuns you.
Watch for Destiny. When Twisted Fate uses it and then recasts to teleport, he can show up behind you, so keep your Living Shadow ready to swap out.
Hit Twisted Fate with Shadow Slash and Razor Shuriken together, so your Shadow's hits also slow him.
Walk through the edge of Event Horizon only if you must; if you stand inside the cage you aren't stunned. Check where Veigar puts it before you jump in.
Move as soon as you see the Dark Matter circle, because it lands after a short delay and can be sidestepped.
Aim Razor Shuriken through the minions at Veigar. It hits every enemy in its path, so it can poke him from behind the wave.
Save Living Shadow until Veigar's Event Horizon is on cooldown, so you can go in and swap out safely.
Veigar is fragile; Death Mark and a full combo can kill him quickly, so go in once Event Horizon is used.
Keep Living Shadow and Death Mark dashes in mind: Vex's Doom 'n Gloom marks you when you dash near her, and her next hit on you deals extra damage.
Dashing in while Vex has Doom 'n Gloom ready is risky, because her next basic ability can fear you and interrupt the dash. Wait for her to spend it first.
Step out of the wide Mistral Bolt line, which is slow at first. Then use Razor Shuriken to poke her back while she waits on cooldown.
Death Mark makes you untargetable as you dash, so use it to avoid Vex's Shadow Surge. Her spell then cannot be recast on you.
Look for the all-in when Personal Space is on cooldown. Without its shield and shockwave, Vex is much easier to burst.
Stay out of Looming Darkness's landing spot, since it slows you. Your Living Shadow can still threaten her from a different angle.
Walk out of Gravity Field the moment it lands; staying inside gets you slowed and then stunned.
Wait until Viktor has used Gravity Field before you dive in with Death Mark.
Hit Viktor with Razor Shuriken while he walks up for a last hit, then use Shadow Slash to slow him and lower Living Shadow's cooldown.
Dodge the Hextech Ray line by stepping sideways; it is narrow, and the aftershock explodes along the same line a moment later.
Leave Arcane Storm's area quickly; it follows you, so get out of it with a Living Shadow swap.
Don't use Death Mark on Vladimir while Sanguine Pool is ready. He can become untargetable and punish you.
Stay out of Sanguine Pool. Wait until it ends before you go in, since it slows you and hurts.
Don't trade into Transfusion early. It heals Vladimir and he wins long fights, so look for short bursts.
Hit Vladimir with Razor Shuriken from range while his Sanguine Pool is on cooldown.
Close the distance on Xerath; he is strong at range, and most of his spells are weaker when you are on top of him.
Sidestep Shocking Orb; it only stuns the first enemy it hits, so keep minions away from the line when you can.
Walk sideways while Xerath charges Arcanopulse; it is harder to hit when you move across its line.
When Xerath channels Rite of the Arcane, dodge each blast as it lands; Death Mark makes you untargetable while you dash in.
Use Living Shadow to get out of Eye of Destruction's slow, and swap back to the Shadow to flee after you trade.
Stay out of Xin Zhao's range when Three Talon Strike is ready. The third hit knocks you up, which gets you killed.
Use Razor Shuriken from far away to poke Xin Zhao. He has no long-range answer except Audacious Charge.
Do not use Death Mark right into Crescent Guard. Wait until he has used it, or Zed's team will be unable to hit him.
Keep a Living Shadow ready to swap away when Xin Zhao charges in with Audacious Charge.
Don't waste Razor Shuriken when Yasuo can raise Wind Wall; wait until it is on cooldown, then throw it.
Yasuo can knock you up with his whirlwind, and Last Breath then pulls him to you. Dodge the whirlwind when he has two stacks.
Swap with your shadow from Death Mark to escape after the mark goes on Yasuo, since he can't reach you easily.
Use Shadow Slash with your shadow in range so Yasuo is slowed. It also shortens Living Shadow's cooldown.
Throw Razor Shuriken so it passes through minions and also hits Yone, and send a Living Shadow out first so its shuriken hits as well.
Use Shadow Slash from your Shadow's side so Yone is slowed, then step back out of his range.
Do not fight in the few seconds after Yone's Mortal Steel reaches its second hit. His knock up dash wrecks a Zed who stays close.
Save Death Mark for when Yone has used Soul Unbound, or hit him with your full combo first so the mark stores lots of damage.
Place a Shadow with Death Mark before he trades back, then swap to it so you escape before the mark triggers.
Use Living Shadow to reach past Zoe's range, and swap in only when her Sleepy Trouble Bubble is on cooldown.
Sidestep Paddle Star! at long range; it hurts a lot more the further it has flown.
Don't walk into the fog or walls near Zoe; Sleepy Trouble Bubble flies much further over walls and puts you to sleep.
Death Mark Zoe when her Sleepy Trouble Bubble is used; she has little to stop you.
Hit Zoe right after she uses Portal Jump; she cannot move and must return to her start.
